description: Claude Code configuration for HRIS-Stery project

preEdit.name: phase-2-block
preEdit.description: Block edits to Phase 2 services (payroll, recruitment, performance)
preEdit.message: ❌ Phase 2 features are blocked. ADR-0004: Payroll, recruitment, and performance are deferred to Phase 2. Return 501 Not Implemented.

preEdit.name: adr-reminder
preEdit.description: Remind to check ADR before modifying a service
preEdit.message: 📋 Remember: Check relevant ADR in docs/adr/ before implementing. Use adr-review skill.

preEdit.name: rls-reminder
preEdit.description: Remind about RLS when touching tables with tenant_id
preEdit.message: 🔒 Reminder: All tenant-scoped tables need FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and tenant_isolation policy. Run migration-review skill.

preEdit.name: migration-down-check
preEdit.description: Require both up and down migration files
preEdit.message: ⬇️ Reminder: Every .up.sql migration needs a corresponding .down.sql file that fully reverses it. Run migration-review skill.

preEdit.name: proto-before-handler
preEdit.description: Remind to check proto contract before implementing handler
preEdit.message: 📝 Reminder: Proto contract must exist in proto/hris/{domain}/v1/ before implementing handler. Run proto-review skill.

preEdit.name: controller-logic-limit
preEdit.description: Warn if Laravel controller might be too large
preEdit.message: 🎯 Reminder: Laravel controllers must be ≤20 lines of logic. Delegate to Service classes. Run laravel-gateway-reviewer.

preEdit.name: no-global-state
preEdit.description: Block package-level database/service variables in Go
preEdit.message: ⚠️ Check: No package-level globals (var db, logger, etc). Use constructor injection. Run go-backend-reviewer.

postCommit.name: go-lint-check
postCommit.description: Run go vet on Go changes
postCommit.command: cd services && for svc in auth-service employee-service; do cd $svc && go vet ./... || exit 1; cd ..; done
postCommit.message: ⚠️ go vet found issues. Fix before pushing.

postCommit.name: migration-reversibility
postCommit.description: Warn if migration down file might not be reversible
postCommit.message: ℹ️ Verify migration reversibility: Check that .down.sql fully reverses .up.sql and drops in correct order.

adr-review.description: Check if ADR exists and is relevant before writing code

proto-review.description: Verify proto contracts exist before implementing gRPC handlers

migration-review.description: Ensure migrations are reversible and have RLS on tenant-scoped tables

event-review.description: Check event envelope structure and idempotency patterns

architecture-review.description: Verify clean architecture boundaries and business logic placement

go-style-review.description: Check Go type safety, RLS context injection, and error handling

event-nats-reviewer.trigger: code review for NATS event publishing/consumption

decisionTree.description: Decision tree for choosing which skill/subagent to use
